cut.name: obj_king_body — the whole object
cut.evidence: gml_Object_obj_king_body_Step_0.gml:1 gates everything on `keyboard_check(vk_enter) && active == 1 && scr_debug()`. It is a DEBUG ATTACK TESTER that re-implements the same 11 attacks with a fake timer (faketimermax) instead of global.turntimer, no damage/target assignment at all, and `if (attackno <= 11) attack = attackno; else attack = choose(7,8,9,10,11)` as its chooser. Its attack 4 uses bouncer type 0 and its attack 6 uses finalchain type 2 — neither of which the real fight can produce. It is NOT a phase of the Chaos King fight; treat it as a second, non-canonical chooser.

mechanics: ONE enemy object, ONE phase, NO HP gate, NO soul mode change, NO minigame. Encounter 40 (gml_GlobalScript_scr_encountersetup.gml:430-438) puts obj_king_boss alone at (viewX+460, viewY+70) as monstertype 25: HP 2800/2800, AT 8, DF 0, mercymax 999 (gml_GlobalScript_scr_monstersetup.gml:611-620). The battle is STARTED from the cutscene director obj_kingcutscene (gml_Object_obj_kingcutscene_Step_0.gml:948-953 sets global.encounterno = 40, calls scr_encountersetup and creates obj_encounterbasic); everything else in that 3595-line file is scripted spectacle drawn with scr_marker (spr_spadebullet_chunk), not real bullets — there is no second bullet phase hiding in it. The fight is a FIXED 15-TURN SCRIPT driven by `kturn` (gml_Object_obj_king_boss_Step_0.gml:90-121): kturn++ then `attack = kturn` for kturn <= 11, then 12->7, 13->8, 14->10, 15->9. HP is decorative — the only HP read (Step_0:168) swaps a battle message. The difficulty ramp is DEFENSE, not attacks: from turn 13 on, `global.monsterdf[myself] -= 5` each turn down to a floor of -25 (Step_0:119-120). Targeting alternates: attacks 2, 5, 10 and 11 call scr_targetall(), everything else scr_randomtarget() (Step_0:125-128). Ralsei's/Susie's ACT chain (acting 2/3/4 with global.tempflag[5..7], Step_0:233-338) unlocks the three party ACTs and — via `tempattack = 0.8` (Step_0:262) — is the only thing that can scale King's damage. Attacks 4, 6, 8 and 11 also do `global.invc *= 1.5` on top of `global.invc = reminvc` (Other_15:3), so invincibility frames compound within a turn. Five of the eleven attacks (2, 5, 6, 10, 11) hide the boss (`visible = 0`) and replace the arena with obj_nonsolid_growtangle, which the chain objects then physically drag around the screen; obj_chainking's Destroy (gml_Object_obj_chainking_Destroy_0.gml) restores `visible = 1` and closes both box types. Six attacks (2, 4, 5, 6, 8, 10, 11) park `global.turntimer = 999` and rely on the chain/bouncer writing `global.turntimer = 3` when they finish. The fight ends unconditionally on turn 15: Step_0:84-88 sets battlecancel = 2, Step_0:177-193 turns that into con = 1, and Step_0:196-218 runs `global.flag[247] = 1; scr_monsterdefeat(); event_user(10); instance_destroy();` handing control back to obj_kingcutscene (Other_20 makes the cutscene King visible again with spr_chainking_hurt if flag 247 was 0).
engineNeeds: 1) DEDUPE KEY COLLISION — this is the blocker. gen_attacks.js:529 keys on `${boss}|${controller}|${type}`, but obj_chainking carries type 1 for THREE attacks (2, 5, 10) and type 2 for TWO (6, 11); the real selector is `subtype`. I ran the generator's own selectorScan logic over Other_15 and it collapses 11 attacks into 8, folding choices 5 and 10 into choice 2 and choice 11 into choice 6. The key needs `|${a.subtype}` (or `|${a.choice}` for ch1 selectorScan bosses), and the id scheme at gen_attacks.js:537 (`${boss}_type${type}`) needs the same — chaosking_type1 would otherwise name three different attacks. 2) CONTROLLER MIS-DETECTION — the scan's controller regex takes the FIRST instance_create in the window, and six King branches (1, 3, 4, 7, 8, 9) create the BOX first, so `controller` comes out obj_growtangle instead of obj_dbulletcontroller / obj_growtangle_bouncer. Harmless while setup replay succeeds (the studio only uses `controller` to find mainInst afterwards), but it makes mainInst the battle box, and the manual fallback at gml_studio.html:1805-1830 would spawn a growtangle-as-controller if a replay ever errors. 3) DEFAULT-BOX PRE-CREATE — gml_studio.html:1785-1789 creates an obj_growtangle at (320,170) whenever none exists yet, which for other bosses is already satisfied by the boxBlock replay. King has no boxBlock, so that fires and then the setup replay creates a SECOND box for attacks 1/3/4/7/8/9, and an unwanted visible growtangle alongside the nonsolid box for 2/5/6/10/11. The pre-create must be skipped when the roster declares boxBlock: null. 4) obj_nonsolid_growtangle IS THE ARENA for five attacks and the studio knows nothing about it — `grep nonsolid_growtangle docs/gml_studio.html` returns zero hits. syncGrowtangle() (gml_studio.html:1658-1662) only looks for obj_growtangle, so runtime.growtangle and centreSoulOn() point at the wrong box and the soul spawns outside the playfield. obj_wavechain and obj_finalchain also address `obj_nonsolid_growtangle.x/.y` directly every step (and MOVE it), so the soul-clamp has to follow that instance. 5) SUPPORT OBJECTS — already translated into docs/js/gml_objects.js ch1: obj_chainking, obj_wavechain, obj_finalchain, obj_chainpiece, obj_skychain, obj_fadechain, obj_growtangle_bouncer, obj_nonsolid_growtangle, obj_regularbullet, obj_regularbullet_permanent, obj_moveheart, obj_shake, obj_dbulletcontroller, obj_king_boss. MISSING: obj_heartmarker — it has no events at all (pure marker: sprite spr_diamondbullet_form, visible False, per Chapter 1 objects.tsv) but Other_15 does `hm = instance_create(box.x - 10, box.y - 10, obj_heartmarker); scr_moveheart(); with (hm) instance_destroy();` in six branches, so the class must at least be instantiable or those branches throw. 6) global.invc must be a live number before replay and should be reset to reminvc (Other_15:3, outside the branches, so setup replay never restores it) — otherwise repeated launches of attacks 4/6/8/11 compound *1.5 forever. 7) obj_growtangle_bouncer sets `obj_growtangle.megakeep = 1` on Create and then WRITES obj_growtangle.x/y every step; obj_wavechain/obj_finalchain do `with (obj_growtangle) megakeep = 1` too. The studio must let the attack own the box position rather than re-centring it. 8) The boss instance needs xx/yy (Create_0:39-40, view origin) and mytarget = 3 (Create_0:31), tempattack = 1 (Create_0:41), chain_dragging = 0 (Create_0:47), reminvc (Create_0:43) — all in Create, so an ordinary boss-Create run covers it. 9) event_user(2) on obj_growtangle_bouncer maps to Other_12, which does `with (obj_king_body) active = 1;` — obj_king_body will not exist, and a `with` over an unknown class must be a no-op, not a throw.
